labels.text: “Only a drawing of the old door.”

turns.text: The following morning Nia reached the station first. The ticket office window bore a faded sign:
“CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE”
. She remembered the previous night's key. Mara arrived with a notebook.
“Did you find anything?”
she asked. Leo came in behind her.
“Only a drawing of the old door.”
Nia turned to him.
“Show me.”
The three of them bent over the page. A child had drawn a small star beside the hinge. Nia smiled at the careless sketch. 😊
